scope: candidate-only same-packet MoveCards dependency regression and native revalidation

regressionBeforeFix.failureSignal: six sanitized browser errors with diagnosticCode=2; retired opaque reference was unknown or stale

rootCause.classification: same-packet dependency rejected during all-entry preflight
rootCause.description: The projector may emit a later transition that retires an opaque reference minted by an earlier transition in the same MoveCards packet. The client preflighted every entry before applying any entry, so that valid intra-packet reference appeared unseen.
rootCause.privacyPosture: fail-closed rejection was preserved; the fix does not accept unknown or stale references outside the simulated packet chain

fix.behavior: preflight the complete packet on a private clone, simulate the legacy area transition between entries, then apply each validated transition sequentially on the live room

syntheticProbe.newRegression: draw-to-hand followed by public discard in one MoveCards packet; intermediate opaque token retired at the public transition

cleanup.launcherExit: Native QA exit -9 after controlled interrupt

releaseLimits: This revalidation closes the observed MoveCards regression on one exact candidate runtime; it is not production or canary approval.

The current release checkpoint is locally rebuilt from the same runtime identity but remains HOLD because the checkout is dirty and separate performance, device/network, rollback-SLA and release approvals are open.
No candidate runtime was promoted to production.
